title: GALAXIAS
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Years after the assassination of the Dragon King, Jio, a human girl in a rural corner of a kingdom of tailed dragonfolk, longs for adventure. She meets Neraid, an amnesiac young man with a dragon tail, and the two set off on a journey through a world of military forces, conspiracies and giant monsters.
life_message: Courage and curiosity are worth leaving home for, and finding out who you are is part of the adventure.
